name: Kpopping Online Wallpapers
description: Online wallpapers in Ambxst's Wallpapers tab. kpopping.com: search K-pop idols and groups (ranked matches, recent searches, infinite scroll, Hot / Newest / Most liked, orientation and SD-8K chips), preview on an empty workspace, keep or drop it from the notch, saved as <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/<Group>/<Idol>/. YouTube: search or paste a link, play videos as a live wallpaper (muted, controls in the notch), My playlist, Up next queue, loop / shuffle / autoplay, quality matched to your screen. Also a Wallpaper fit setting for skwd-wall and a faster-opening picker.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Queries kpopping.com's public API (no login, no cookies) when you search in Kpopping mode

Downloads thumbnails (via kpopping.com's image resizer) and full-size photos (from its Cloudflare R2 bucket) into ~/.cache/ambxst/kpopping; thumbnails unused for 30 days and previews older than 7 days are deleted, except a preview that is still your wallpaper
Copies the photo you pick into <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/
Desktop previews close the dashboard, switch to an empty workspace and set the cached photo as your wallpaper (colours included) until you keep or drop it from the notch
Writes display.fillMode / display.backgroundMode in skwd-wall's ~/.config/skwd-wall-v2/config.json before each wallpaper change (the Wallpaper fit setting; 'Leave it to skwd-wall' turns this off)
Keeps My playlist, the YouTube chips and recent YouTube searches in ~/.config/ambxst/kpopping-youtube.json

YouTube mode searches and lists videos with yt-dlp, and plays the one you pick with mpvpaper (mpv) on the desktop. yt-dlp downloads each video straight into a pipe the player reads, nothing saved to disk. The player keeps running across shell reloads until you stop it or choose another wallpaper
